scenarios.name: spare_request_requester_is_distinct_historical_role
prove: requester and receiver may be different active Contacts
Spare Request preserves immutable requester Contact identity plus bounded REQUESTER_CONTEXT_V1 effective at creation
receiver remains a separate logistics role
later Contact affiliation/descriptive change does not rewrite requester history
terminal request continues to display original requester relationship/context alongside current Contact context

scenarios.name: active_requester_blocks_contact_archive
prove: active nonterminal Spare Request requester relationship returns BLOCKED through InventoryReferenceDependencyValidator
LLD-02 Contact archive fails closed on BLOCKED or INDETERMINATE
once the Spare Request is terminal this requester dependency may become CLEAR
terminal requester Contact relationship and creation-time context remain immutable history

rule: These cases provide explicit supporting coverage for BETA-REQ-0032 without promoting Contact-role authority into LLD-07's governing requirement set.
